messages:
maya: Heads up — Acme reported ~120k embed rows missing from 2026-02-14 02:00-03:00Z window. Seen by billing?
ashok: Looking now. Any commonalities (sdk, region, plan)?
maya: They said SDK v3.2.1 with client-side debounce enabled; high-rate batched streams to eu-west-1. They attached sample logs.
billing-bot: Incident created: MTR-4578 — Deferred metering detected for embed pipeline. Assigned: @ashok
ashok: grabbing ingest logs and offsets. ETA ~20m.
ben: quick note — our pause-window aggregator batches events up to 45s. If flush path errors, events are marked deferred and only included in the 6h backfill window. Could lead to hour holes.
maya: snippet from their logs: ```WARN pause-window flush failed shard=12 err=timeout retrying in 5s```
ashok: found matching traces: shard=12 had leader election in kafka at 02:07:11Z, acks dropped, downstream consumer committed lower offset. Events flagged deferred=true.
maria: if accurate, finance impact? They were invoiced for only ~1/3 of embeds that hour.
ben: rough calc: 120,000 missing embeddings x $0.0004 = $48.00. We'll need a credit and replay backfill.
maya: request: approval to run urgent backfill (low-risk replay) and issue provisional credit of $50 pending final recount.
ashok: technical ok to backfill. I'll coordinate with infra to bump retry window and watch for duplicates.
leo: ops/legal check — credits > $25 need finance lead + ops lead sign-off per policy. Tagging @maria and @nina.
maria: I approve provisional $50 credit. Use reason code: MTR-DEFERRED-2141592653. Please include supporting log excerpts in ticket.
nina: ops approves the backfill; confirm idempotency checks in replay.
maya: customer-facing: please advise support to notify Acme about the provisional credit and backfill ETA.
support-bot: Support ticket created: SUP-9124 — Customer notified, awaiting confirm.
ashok: scheduling backfill job now. Command: ```/admin-tools metering replay --from=2026-02-14T02:00Z --to=2026-02-14T03:00Z --shard=12 --priority=urgent --idempotency=on```
billing-bot: Backfill job queued: job_id=j-9a7c, expected run 4h, status=queued
maria: please attach final recount and adjust invoice if difference > $1.
ben: will run recount after job completes and validate commit offsets + dedupe markers.
maya: evan — can SDK debounce default be revisited? This customer had it enabled by default for high-throughput streams.
evAN: (evan) noted typo in ping but saw it — will open an SDK config PR to reduce default debounce for streaming metrics.
maya: thanks. I'll update thread with job progress and final numbers.
ashok: backfill started. Monitoring logs for duplicates; dedupe watermark in place.
ashok: UPDATE 3h: backfill finished, replayed 118,942 events, deduped 2,148 duplicates, net restored: 116,794 embeddings.
maria: final recount received. Final credit: $46.72 (rounded to $47). Finance to post adjustment.
maya: customer notified and credited. Closing incident when invoice adjustment posts.
ben: note for postmortem: consider reducing deferred window from 6h to 1h and add faster on-demand replay trigger for critical customers.
maria: agreed. Filing change request CR-2141.
maya: thread closed once adjustment shows on invoice. Thanks everyone.
